## User problem

Who needs this, and what can they not do with the existing CLI/SDK?

## Proposed behavior

Describe one concrete before/after example and how it could be verified.
Explain why it belongs in the generic host rather than an authored Space page
or handler. Identify any new file, network, account or external-action authority.

## Scope

What is the smallest useful change? Which current behavior must remain intact?
Do not include private data, credentials or vulnerability details; security
reports belong in the private advisory form linked from SECURITY.md.
